bestBets.overview: On pace runners 4 and 6. IKON PARK was very good on debut here on the heavy track. Much better for the run and in this not overly strong maiden he is the one to beat. FORGIVE ME FATHER trialled well before a fair debut on the Acton track at Canberra when well fancied. In a strong stable he can be an improver. PIRATESS has shown some ability on the wet tracks. The 1`st starter SAVAGENTO trialled fairly on the heavy track here. EIGHTEEN MONTHS best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,2 and 3. VALENTINE JOHN ran 2nd at Grafton last start over 3100 metres. He is a winner on the heavy ground and with the light weight will get his chance. COUNTY KILKENNY loves the heavy tracks but he does get the 2500 metres for the 1st time which is some query. MR TADASHI won 3 straight here on the heavy ground before being a bit disappointing last start. He is a winner over 2200 metres. Rough chances to HELLS SPIRIT and IT IS TO BE.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 2 and 7. PARIAH FLYER made good ground when resuming in a BM66 race at Albury on the heavy ground. She will appreciate getting to the 1300 metres and was a winner 2nd up last time in. DEMMO DERMY was an easy winner 2 runs back and then was pulled up at Newcastle last start. He has since been freshened up and trialled very well at Randwick. XERXES did enough when resuming and he is another one who enjoys these conditions. LET UP rising in class can measure up.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 2,6,7 and 8. BRIAL ROSE led throughout for an easy win here last start on the heavy ground. This a little tougher but she does drop 6kgs in weight so is sure to give a sight. BRENLYN'S LEGACY had a very tough run when resuming as favourite. His form last time in was very good so expect him to be an improver today. BIG DAY OUT was outclassed last start at Flemington so he is another one who can bounce back. EAMONN'S MEMORY and METALLIC RULER have rough chances.

In this not overly strong race he will get his chance. The Victorian CALL ME RHONDA is racing very well down there on the wet tracks. ICONIC ROSE next best.

He will enjoy getting to the 1400 metres and just needs a bit of luck from the bad barrier. The other Victorian BRILLIANT BULL ANT is racing well down there on the wet tracks. I'VE FORGOTTEN was very good his 2nd race start on the heavy track at Albury. He too will appreciate getting to this distance. MR REIBY has been fair both his runs to date. He will find this a little easier than his last start at Kembla Grange.
